svg.text: Same catalog, same profile, same depot. The qualified path adds Quality's decisions at the profile, the IQ at the build, and OQ, approval and change control after delivery.

svg.text: Lead time about 1–3 weeks either way; an incomplete profile is the main cause of rework. A qualified rebuild is a separate service because it repeats the evidence. Controls: GAMP 5; GxP system lifecycle.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
